customers_say: Customers find the door lock convenient to use with a user-friendly app, and appreciate its premium design that looks like a simple door handle. They praise its build quality, security features, and installation process, and consider it a good value for money. The lock's reliability receives mixed feedback, with some customers reporting it performs as expected while others find it laggy.

reviews.author: Shreyas Patil
reviews.title: The live video feature is commendable.
reviews.body: Fantastic purchase... The live video feature is commendable. Helps me stay at ease as far as security is concerned. The premium build makes the door look very lively.

reviews.author: Gagan Deep
reviews.title: Great Smart Lock with Premium Features
reviews.body: Great smart lock! Premium design, easy to use, and the app features like remote unlocking, live view and instant notifications work really well. Feels secure and premium. Happy with the purchase! Worth the price.

reviews.author: swaroopbhat
reviews.title: Best smart lock with amazing features!
reviews.body: Just got the native lock installed at my place. The quality, finish and features they offer is just mind-blowing! The locking and unlocking of the door is soo smooth. I got it installed for my parents and they're really enjoying it (especially the fingerprint) as it's very convenient for them now!

reviews.author: Tamal Ghosh
reviews.title: Not flawless
reviews.body: This product is good but it has a major design flaw. None of my guests able to open the door when they leave the home. I always have to open the door if the visitor is new. Opening door from the inside is non intuitive, hidden behind the handle and very confusing. Nobody still today able to open the door in the first time without asking us to open the door for them. I think I have been using it for 3 months now and still finding a smart one who can open the door in first trial. May be I sound like too dramatic and making it a big deal on small issue. reviews.author: Lohith N
reviews.title: Free from keys!
reviews.body: Delivery was prompt. Installation took time and was dusty but was done neatly. Have been using it from >15 days and I would say it's made my life easy one (key less) at a time! Pros: No need to carry keys, no need to ask someone at home to lock the door when going out as it automatically locks. Camera unlocks even if it's dark. Battery is at 70% even after >15 days. Good job UC. Product price is at a higher end but worth. Cons: Mine was a heavy Honne wood door and sometimes the door gets stuck (mostly due to weather changes) instead of opening but it's the door and not the lock.
